hook.name: VoltageHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that captures a 3% fee on every ETH/VOLT swap: sell fees are taken in ETH and immediately distributed (70% to VOLT holders weighted by balance × time-held multiplier, 30% to a capacitor reserve for holders with ≥100 VOLT); buy fees are collected as VOLT tokens and converted to ETH via a permissionless convertVoltageFee() call.
